moments.text: Infrared sensor view: crosshair at centre over a grey, mottled background with diagonal streaks. Black redaction boxes cover the edges.
The picture briefly turns grainy with horizontal streaks, then clears.
A small dark spot shows just below the crosshair and stays close to it, wandering below and then to the right of the crosshair.
After fading into the darker background, the dark spot shows again below the crosshair and drifts down toward the bottom of the frame.
The dark spot is clearest here, against a lighter patch lower right of the crosshair, moving back up toward it as the clip ends.
